Not dreams but schemes to the ways and means Keen on CREAM Build our reality. No remorse. No maladies. Just a course of Formalities. author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Keep your hopes and dreams
Works for you, fine
Me and mine
More philosophy of Wu
No hope. Only grind.
Not dreams but schemes
to the ways and means
Keen on CREAM
Build our reality.
No remorse. No
maladies.
Just a course of
Formalities.
Our vision isn't
Wishin to gather at
hope's heatless hearth
But spark a flame
Seen miles from this Earth.
